# Task 02 — Leave end witness

## Objective

Write the witness file `done.flag` at the root; last trivial subtask of the
e2e drain. With the three tasks in `[x]` there are no pending items and the
loop must create `stop.md` next to the plan.

## Linked context

- [Minimal fixture test plan](../plan.md)

## Constraints

- Only files inside the test repo; no network or credentials.

## Happy path (small example)

After the iteration `done.flag` exists, and the next loop turn, with no
pending work, creates `plan/stop.md` and stops with exit 0.

## Subtasks

- [ ] Write `done.flag` at the root with the line `done`.
